connections.choice.default.description: The first choice of connection: the workspace's default connection for the CLI, named ({name}).

connections.choice.defaultNone.description: The first choice of connection when the workspace has no connection on for the CLI: an agent on it is refused a start until one is.

connections.choice.gone.defaultMessage: A removed connection (the agent is refused a start)
connections.choice.gone.description: A choice of connection that no longer exists: the agent can't start until another is chosen.

connections.choice.label.description: Label of the choice of connection an agent runs on (Agent Settings, Add Agent, Settings → Assistant): which login or service runs it.

connections.choice.none.defaultMessage: No {cli} connection is on in this workspace. Add one in Settings → Connections.
connections.choice.none.description: Under the choice of connection when the workspace has none on for the CLI ({cli}: "Claude Code"). Settings → Connections names a section.

connections.choice.off.defaultMessage: {name} (off in this workspace: the default runs it)
connections.choice.off.description: A choice of connection that is chosen but off in this workspace ({name}): the workspace's default runs the agent instead.

connections.choice.otherCli.description: A group in the choice of connection: the connections of another coding agent CLI ({cli}: "Codex"). Picking one switches the agent to that CLI (it is asked first).

connections.mark.anotherMark.defaultMessage: Running on another connection than the one chosen
connections.mark.anotherMark.description: Accessible label of the ⟳ mark beside a running agent's connection in its row (HI-1769).

connections.mark.deleted.description: An agent's row, in place of its connection (HI-1769): the connection chosen for it was removed, so it can't start until another is chosen. Short.

connections.mark.deletedTip.defaultMessage: The connection chosen for it was removed: it can't start until you choose another in its Agent Settings, or the workspace's default.
connections.mark.deletedTip.description: The hover of an agent's row whose chosen connection was removed (HI-1769). Agent Settings names a dialog.

connections.mark.inherited.defaultMessage: {name}: the workspace's default for {cli}, which it follows
connections.mark.inherited.description: The hover of an agent's connection in its row (HI-1769): it has no connection of its own, so it runs on the workspace's default ({name}) for its CLI ({cli}: "Claude Code"), and follows it if the default changes.

connections.mark.none.description: An agent's row, in place of its connection (HI-1769): the workspace has no connection on for its CLI, so it can't start. Short.

connections.mark.noneTip.defaultMessage: No {cli} connection is on in this workspace: it can't start until one is (Settings → Connections).
connections.mark.noneTip.description: The hover of an agent's row (HI-1769): no connection is on in this workspace for its CLI ({cli}: "Claude Code"). Settings → Connections names a section.

connections.mark.offFallback.defaultMessage: {wanted} is off in this workspace: the default, {name}, runs it
connections.mark.offFallback.description: The hover of an agent's connection in its row (HI-1769): its own connection ({wanted}) is off in this workspace, so the workspace's default ({name}) runs it.

connections.mark.offNoDefault.description: An agent's row, in place of its connection (HI-1769): its own connection ({wanted}) is off in this workspace and no other is on to run it. Short.

connections.mark.offNoDefaultTip.defaultMessage: {wanted} is off in this workspace, and no other {cli} connection is on: it can't start until one is (Settings → Connections).
connections.mark.offNoDefaultTip.description: The hover of an agent's row (HI-1769): its own connection ({wanted}) is off here and the workspace has no other connection on for its CLI ({cli}). Settings → Connections names a section.

connections.mark.other.defaultMessage: Runs on {running} until it restarts. Chosen now: {chosen}
connections.mark.other.description: The hover of a running agent's connection in its row (HI-1769, shown with a ⟳ mark): its run is on one connection ({running}) and the one it would start on now is another ({chosen}: a connection's name, or why none can run it). It keeps the one it runs on until it restarts.

connections.mark.otherProvider.description: An agent's row, in place of its connection (HI-1769): the connection chosen for it belongs to another coding agent CLI, so it can't start on it. Short.

connections.mark.otherProviderTip.defaultMessage: {wanted} is for another CLI than {cli}: it can't start until you choose one of its own in its Agent Settings.
connections.mark.otherProviderTip.description: The hover of an agent's row whose chosen connection ({wanted}) belongs to another CLI than its own ({cli}) (HI-1769). Agent Settings names a dialog.

connections.mark.own.description: The hover of an agent's connection in its row (HI-1769): the connection ({name}) was chosen for it in its Agent Settings.
